pharmacy.name: BloomCare Pharmacy
pharmacy.licensing: Licensed by the National Drug Authority (NDA) Uganda (#NDA/UG/PHARM/2026/894)
pharmacy.location: Near Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital, Opposite Rubis Station, Near Mbarara Central Police Station, Mbarara City, Uganda
pharmacy.hours: Open 24/7 for digital orders & urgent dispatch; physical dispensary open 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM Daily

delivery.speed: Express 10–15 minutes doorstep delivery within Mbarara City
delivery.coverage: Kamukuzi, Kakoba, Nyamitanga, Ruharo, Biharwe, Kakiika, Nyakayojo, and surrounding Mbarara City divisions
delivery.packaging: Orders are packed in our official tamper-evident branded BloomCare paper dispensary bags.

prescriptions.policy: Prescription-only medicines (marked Rx) strictly require clinical verification by a registered pharmacist.
prescriptions.howToUpload: Add the medicine to your order, proceed to checkout, and upload a clear photo or PDF scan of your prescription. Our pharmacists review it prior to dispensing.
prescriptions.bypassRule: Prescriptions cannot be bypassed. This is mandated by the National Drug Authority for patient safety.

returns.policy: Due to pharmaceutical cold-chain and safety regulations, dispensed medicines cannot be returned once delivered, unless damaged or dispensed in error.

faqs.question: What are your operating hours?
faqs.answer: BloomCare Pharmacy offers 24/7 online ordering and rapid doorstep dispatch across Mbarara City. Our physical central dispensary is open 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM every day.

faqs.question: How much is delivery and how fast does it arrive?
faqs.answer: Delivery is UGX 5,000 across Mbarara City and arrives in approximately 10–15 minutes via our dedicated delivery couriers. All orders are packed in tamper-evident BloomCare bags.

faqs.question: How do I submit or upload my prescription?
faqs.answer: Add your needed prescription medication to the cart, head to checkout, and click 'Upload Prescription' to attach a photo or PDF. A licensed BloomCare pharmacist will clinically review and verify it.

faqs.question: Can I talk directly to a licensed pharmacist?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can book a 1-on-1 medication consultation in the Consultations tab or reach our Care Desk directly on WhatsApp at 0750210886.

faqs.question: What payment methods are supported?
faqs.answer: We accept MTN Mobile Money (076, 077, 078), Airtel Money (070, 074, 075), and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible local orders.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Go to 'My Orders' and click 'Track Order'. You will see real-time 6-stage delivery progression, assigned driver details, and can chat directly with your courier.
